/-- 概要：同じ辺の二つの cofiber 対象はホモトピー圏で同型である。
方針：四角形の比較同型を終端頂点で評価する。
規約：値域は quasicategory。使われ方：cofiber の零性の輸送。 -/
def cofiberSquareComparisonIso {X : SSet.{u}} [Quasicategory X]
    {x y : X _⦋0⦌} {f : SSet.Truncated.Edge (X := (truncation 2).obj X) x y}
    (s t : _root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HA.StableInfinityCategories.ZeroObjects.CofiberSquare f) : _root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.KanComplexes.TheHomotopyTheoryOfKanComplexes.VertexIso s.cofiber t.cofiber := by
  let e := Classical.choice (nonempty_cofiberSquareFunctorIso s t)
  let v : ((Δ[1] : SSet.{u}) ⊗ Δ[1]) _⦋0⦌ :=
    (stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.symm (1 : Fin 2), stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.symm (1 : Fin 2))
  let q := _root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.TheHomotopyTheoryOfInfinityCategories.Equivalence.evaluateFunctorAt (Y := X) v
  have hs : q.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) (_root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.KanComplexes.TheHomotopyTheoryOfKanComplexes.functorVertex s.square) = s.cofiber := by
    rw [_root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.TheHomotopyTheoryOfInfinityCategories.Equivalence.evaluateFunctorAt_functorVertex]
    rfl
  have ht : q.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) (_root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.KanComplexes.TheHomotopyTheoryOfKanComplexes.functorVertex t.square) = t.cofiber := by
    rw [_root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.TheHomotopyTheoryOfInfinityCategories.Equivalence.evaluateFunctorAt_functorVertex]
    rfl
  exact (eqToIso (congrArg SSet.HomotopyCategory.mk hs)).symm ≪≫
    _root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.KanComplexes.TheHomotopyTheoryOfKanComplexes.VertexIso.map e q ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg SSet.HomotopyCategory.mk ht)

def binaryProductOfRetraction_of_arrow_eq {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {A B D A' B' D' : C} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}
    {f' : A' ⟶ B'} {g' : B' ⟶ D'}
    (hp : ∀ (r : B ⟶ A), f ≫ r = 𝟙 A → IsLimit (BinaryFan.mk r g))
    (hf : Arrow.mk f = Arrow.mk f') (hg : Arrow.mk g = Arrow.mk g')
    (r : B' ⟶ A') (hr : f' ≫ r = 𝟙 A') : IsLimit (BinaryFan.mk r g') := by
  apply Classical.choice
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hf⟩ := (Arrow.mk_eq_mk_iff f f').1 hf
  subst A'
  subst B'
  obtain ⟨_, hD, hg⟩ := (Arrow.mk_eq_mk_iff g g').1 hg
  subst D'
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at hf hg
  subst f'
  subst g'
  exact ⟨hp r hr⟩

  let g := sg.1
  let sk := Classical.choice (hx.nonempty_split g)

  have hf : HomotopyCategory₂.homMk f = HomotopyCategory₂.homMk k := by

/-- 元の指定極限への後段は、実切断の制限と同じ普遍辺の標準後合成に全自然。 -/
def setWeightSectionsLimitTail_shapeIso {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I]
    {X Y : I ⥤ Type u} (φ : X ⟶ Y)
    {E : SSet.{u + 1}} [Quasicategory E] (hE : IsPresentable E) (M : E _⦋0⦌)
    (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj (nerve I) ⟶ E)
    (cX : JoinCone (SetWeight.diagram X F)) (hcX : IsLimitCone cX)
    (cY : JoinCone (SetWeight.diagram Y F)) (hcY : IsLimitCone cY) :
    FunctorIso
      ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map
        (setWeightActualSectionsRestriction φ (F ≫ (spaceTensorData hE M).hom)) ≫
          (setWeightSectionsLimitTail X hE M F cX hcX).hom)
      ((setWeightSectionsLimitTail Y hE M F cY hcY).hom ≫
        postcompose M (SSet.Truncated.HomotopyCategory.homMk
          (SetWeight.sectionsMap φ F cX hcX cY hcY))) := by
  let t := spaceTensorData hE M
  let gY := SetWeight.diagram Y (F ≫ t.hom)
  let gX := SetWeight.diagram X (F ≫ t.hom)
  let d := mapJoinCone t.hom (SetWeight.restrictSectionsCone φ F cY)
  have hd : d.val = joinMap (𝟙 (Δ[0] : SSet.{u + 1}))
      ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map (nerveMap φ.mapElements)) ≫
        (mapJoinCone t.hom cY).val := rfl
  have hv : d.vertex = (mapJoinCone t.hom cY).vertex := by
    simp only [d, mapJoinCone_vertex, SetWeight.restrictSectionsCone_vertex]
  let e := setWeightMappedSectionsConeEdge φ F cX hcX cY t.hom
  let δ := SetWeight.sectionsMap φ F cX hcX cY hcY
  have he : coneApexEdgeAt e (mapJoinCone t.hom cY).vertex hv = δ.map t.hom := by
    apply SSet.Edge.ext
    change (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun z ↦ SSet.Edge z (mapJoinCone t.hom cX).vertex) hv)
      (e.map (sliceOverProjection gX))).edge = _
    rw [edge_source_transport_simplex hv]
    exact setWeightMappedSectionsConeEdge_simplex φ F cX hcX cY hcY t.hom
  have h := sectionsLimitValue_normalizedShapeIso gY gX (nerveMap φ.mapElements)
    (SetWeight.elementsMap_diagram φ (F ≫ t.hom))
    (mapJoinCone t.hom cY) (mapJoinCone_isLimit_of_adjunction t.adjunction cY hcY)
    (mapJoinCone t.hom cX) (mapJoinCone_isLimit_of_adjunction t.adjunction cX hcX)
    d hd hv e
  rw [he] at h
  have h₀ := FunctorIso.postcomp h (spaceTensorHomValueTail t cX.vertex).hom
  have h₁ := FunctorIso.precomp (spaceTensorHomValueTail_edgeIso t δ)
    ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map
      (sectionsLimitValueEquivalence gY (mapJoinCone t.hom cY)
        (mapJoinCone_isLimit_of_adjunction t.adjunction cY hcY)).hom)
  simp only [Category.assoc] at h₀ h₁
  simpa only [setWeightSectionsLimitTail, setWeightActualSectionsRestriction,
    spaceTensorHomValueTail, QCatEquivalence.trans, IsQCatEquivalence.choose,
    Category.assoc, t, gX, gY, δ] using h₀ ≪≫ h₁

/-- 概要：余極限の cocone の各脚を pullback した cocone は余極限。
方針：任意の cocone の値を fiber 上の関数として貼り、pullback の一意性で計算則を確認する。
規約：底の型と各型は宇宙 u、添字の宇宙は任意。
使われ方：Kerodon Proposition 5.2.4.5（Tag 024R）、単体集合の相対 join のセルと骨格への拡張。 -/
noncomputable def types_isColimit_of_pullback {J : Type v} [Category.{w} J]
    {D E : J ⥤ Type u} (c : Cocone D) (hc : IsColimit c) (d : Cocone E)
    (α : E ⟶ D) (f : d.pt ⟶ c.pt)
    (hp : ∀ j, IsPullback (d.ι.app j) (α.app j) f (c.ι.app j)) : IsColimit d := by
  classical
  let l (j : J) (x : D.obj j) (y : {y : d.pt // f y = c.ι.app j x}) : E.obj j :=
    (Types.exists_of_isPullback (hp j) y.val x y.property).choose
  have hl₁ (j : J) (x : D.obj j) (y : {y : d.pt // f y = c.ι.app j x}) :
      d.ι.app j (l j x y) = y.val :=
    (Types.exists_of_isPullback (hp j) y.val x y.property).choose_spec.1
  have hl₂ (j : J) (x : D.obj j) (y : {y : d.pt // f y = c.ι.app j x}) :
      α.app j (l j x y) = x :=
    (Types.exists_of_isPullback (hp j) y.val x y.property).choose_spec.2
  have hsurj (y : d.pt) : ∃ (j : J) (x : E.obj j), d.ι.app j x = y := by
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx⟩ := Types.jointly_surjective D hc (f y)
    exact ⟨j, l j x ⟨y, hx.symm⟩, hl₁ j x ⟨y, hx.symm⟩⟩
  have hex (s : Cocone E) : ∃ m : d.pt ⟶ s.pt, ∀ j, d.ι.app j ≫ m = s.ι.app j := by
    let P (z : c.pt) := {y : d.pt // f y = z} → s.pt
    let a (j : J) (x : D.obj j) : P (c.ι.app j x) := fun y ↦ s.ι.app j (l j x y)
    have ha {j k : J} (q : j ⟶ k) (x : D.obj j) : HEq (a k (D.map q x)) (a j x) := by
      have hcx : (c.ι.app k (D.map q x) : c.pt) = c.ι.app j x := by
        change (D.map q ≫ c.ι.app k) x = c.ι.app j x
        exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (c.w q) x
      apply Function.hfunext
      · exact congrArg (fun z ↦ {y : d.pt // f y = z}) hcx
      · intro y y' hy
        have hyv : y.val = y'.val := (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq (fun z ↦ by
          rw [hcx])).mp hy
        have he : E.map q (l j x y') = l k (D.map q x) y := by
          apply Types.ext_of_isPullback (hp k)
          · have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.w q) (l j x y')
            change d.ι.app k (E.map q (l j x y')) = d.ι.app j (l j x y') at hn
            exact hn.trans ((hl₁ j x y').trans (hyv.symm.trans (hl₁ k (D.map q x) y).symm))
          · have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (α.naturality q) (l j x y')
            change α.app k (E.map q (l j x y')) = D.map q (α.app j (l j x y')) at hn
            exact hn.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ D.map q z) (hl₂ j x y')) |>.trans
              (hl₂ k (D.map q x) y).symm
        apply heq_of_eq
        change s.ι.app k (l k (D.map q x) y) = s.ι.app j (l j x y')
        rw [← he]
        exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (s.w q) (l j x y')
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := _root_.SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Kerodon.FibrationsOfInfinityCategories.CovariantTransport.types_exists_dependentDesc c hc P a ha
    have hb' (z : c.pt) (y : d.pt) (hy : f y = z) :
        b (f y) ⟨y, rfl⟩ = b z ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
      subst z
      rfl
    refine ⟨↾fun y ↦ b (f y) ⟨y, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro j
    apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
    intro x
    have hw := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hp j).w x
    change f (d.ι.app j x) = c.ι.app j (α.app j x) at hw
    change b (f (d.ι.app j x)) ⟨d.ι.app j x, rfl⟩ = s.ι.app j x
    rw [hb' _ _ hw, hb]
    change s.ι.app j (l j (α.app j x) ⟨d.ι.app j x, hw⟩) = s.ι.app j x
    congr 1
    apply Types.ext_of_isPullback (hp j)
    · exact hl₁ _ _ _
    · exact hl₂ _ _ _
  exact
    { desc := fun s ↦ (hex s).choose
      fac := fun s j ↦ (hex s).choose_spec j
      uniq := by
        intro s m hm
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro y
        obtain ⟨j, x, rfl⟩ := hsurj y
        exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hm j) x).trans
          (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((hex s).choose_spec j) x).symm }

def weightedSections_discrete (O : Presheaf C E)
    (hE : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HTT.PresentableInfinityCategories.IsPresentable E)
    (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hP : HasLimit (sectionsOfDiagram P O)) :
    VertexIso ((weightedSections O hE).app _ (SSet.opObjEquiv.symm
      ((discretePresheafInclusion C).val.app _ (nerveVertex P)))) (sectionsOf P O hP) := by
  rw [(discretePresheafInclusion C).property.1 P]
  have hd : HasLimit ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map
      (smallLeftUnstraighteningProjection (discretePresheaf P)) ≫ O) := hE.hasLimit _
  let d := Classical.choose hd
  have hd' := Classical.choose_spec hd
  let ew := weightedSections_originalLeftLimitIso O hE (discretePresheaf P) d hd'
  have ha : IsQCatEquivalence ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map (SetWeight.elementsComparisonNatural P)) :=
    IsQCatEquivalence.ulift.{u, u + 1}
      (SetWeight.elementsComparisonNatural_isPrecompositionEquivalence P).isQCatEquivalence
  have hp : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map (SetWeight.elementsComparisonNatural P) ≫
      (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map
        (smallLeftUnstraighteningProjection (discretePresheaf P)) =
      (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map (nerveMap (Functor.Elements.π P)) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map) (SetWeight.elementsComparisonNatural_projection P)
  let es := limitVertexIsoOfOverEquivalence
    ((SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).map (SetWeight.elementsComparisonNatural P)) ha hp O
    (sectionsOfCone P O hP) d (sectionsOfCone_isLimit P O hP) hd'
  exact ew ≪≫ es.symm

definitions.original_choice_source:
/-- 同じ元の全切断関手の値を、実際の Yoneda の指定局所極限の頂点へ移す。
HTT 5.1.5.6、Kerodon Definition 7.3.1.2（Tag 02Y9）、形状・係数の指定同型の合成則。 -/
def weightedSections_nativeLimitIso (O : Presheaf C E)
    (hE : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HTT.PresentableInfinityCategories.IsPresentable E)
    (P : (PresheafCat C SpaceInfinity.{u}).op _⦋0⦌)
    (d : JoinCone (rightKanDiagram (SSet.opFunctor.map (yonedaInfinityMap (nerve C)))
      ((fixedYonedaDomainIso C).inv ≫ O)
      ((SSet.opFunctor.mapIso (fixedPresheafShapeIso C)).inv.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) P)))
    (hd : IsLimitCone d) : VertexIso ((weightedSections O hE).app _ P) d.vertex := by
  let a := fixedYonedaDomainIso C
  let b := (SSet.opFunctor.mapIso (fixedPresheafShapeIso C)).symm
  let O' := a.inv ≫ O
  have he : a.hom ≫ O' = O := by
    dsimp only [O']
    rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
  let c := Classical.choose (weightedSections_limitValue O hE P)
  have hc := (Classical.choose_spec (weightedSections_limitValue O hE P)).1
  have hlocal : HasLimit (rightKanDiagram (nativeSetShapeOppositeYoneda C) O P) :=
    (hasLimit_fixedYonedaDiagram_iff_nativeShape C O P).mp ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hs : HasLimit (rightKanDiagram (nativeSetShapeOppositeYoneda C) (a.hom ≫ O') P) := by
    rw [he]
    exact hlocal
  let s := Classical.choose hs
  have hs' := Classical.choose_spec hs
  have htransport : ∀ (O₀ : Presheaf C E) (h : O₀ = O)
      (t : JoinCone (rightKanDiagram (nativeSetShapeOppositeYoneda C) O₀ P)),
      IsLimitCone t → VertexIso ((weightedSections O hE).app _ P) t.vertex := by
    intro O₀ h t ht
    cases h
    exact weightedSections_nativeShapeLimitIso O hE P t ht
  let es := htransport (a.hom ≫ O') he s hs'
  let ed := rightKanLimitVertexIsoOfIsoSquare a b
    (nativeSetShapeOppositeYoneda_square C) O' P s d hs' hd
  exact es ≪≫ ed
